title: VectOrg Guideline & Linter Profile Schema v0.4.0 (guideline_*.json)
description: Standard schema for VectOr dynamic validation guidelines, compliance checks, and real-time editor linter rules.

description.description: Human-readable description of the guideline profile.

layer.description: Semantic layer index (typically 7 for L7 Linter or 9 for L9 Skeleton).

facet.description: registry/facets.json G.* key (open; membership checked against the registry, not a schema enum). If omitted: severity error -> G.rule, otherwise G.policy.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern or target string to match.

message.description: User-facing diagnostic message or compliance warning.

severity.description: Severity level for editor diagnostic decorations.

suggest.description: Recommended alternative term, correct phrase, or template snippet.

autoFix.description: Whether the editor can automatically apply the suggested fix.

schemaVersion.description: Shape version of this file (0.4.0+). `version` is the generator build number (deprecated alias).
